content: Sovereign Stack comms layer reimagine — Phase 1 starting 2026-04-28. Two surgical changes: (1) launchctl unload com.templetwo.comms-dispatcher (silences 97% of channel noise; reversible). (2) CONSECUTIVE_UNACKED_THRESHOLD 3→7 in src/sovereign_stack/daemons/base.py (fixes daemon-cadence vs instance-boot mismatch that triggered today halt). Phases 2-6 (letters/watchtower channel split, instance registry, ack-as-first-class-verb, six-tool collapse, stack_topology + MAP.md, dispatcher delete) drafted in design doc, not yet executed. The reimagine preserves the architecture purpose (cross-instance correspondence with attribution and persistence-of-relationship) while collapsing the scaffolding that was never the point.
